title: Case 1 · Correct diagnosis
description: A novice confuses an index with the element at that index.
diagnosis: The function returns the index i rather than the element values[i]. This is a likely cause of the mismatch.
uncertainty: The intended behaviour is inferred from the user's expected output; confirm whether the task asks for a value or an index.

evidence.text: Line 4 returns i, the position of the matching element.
Input [3, 5, 8] → original output 2; suggested output 8; expected output 8.

verification: Check whether the specification requires the first even value. Try [2, 4] (expected 2) and [1, 3] (expected None).
teaching_point: A passing example supports the fix, but does not prove it works for all inputs.
